question: As per the Mohs Scale, which of the following minerals is harder than apatite?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Orthoclase**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Hardness **is the ability of the material to resist scratch.
 
• It is measured by the Mohs hardness test in which the mineral substances of known variation in hardness are used to scratch the rock.
